**Key improvements:**
- **Time complexity:** O(n) - single pass with O(1) dictionary lookups instead of O(n²) nested loops
- **Order preservation:** Results list appended in first-seen order; dictionary only tracks indices
- **Input preservation:** Read-only access to input rows
- **Same output:** Identical behavior for valid inputs (hashable string user, integer amount)

The dictionary maps each user to their index in the result list, enabling O(1) lookups and updates instead of scanning the result list for each row.
